localization-master.title: 好软件值得好评
localization-master.body:
对于立志于要全球化的独立开发者来说，这个软件简直救了我的命！我知道谷歌机器翻译的质量不是完全OK，依然需要手工检查一些重要的词。但是我尊从先有后优的原则。一天搞定30多种语言的适配，总比没有翻译好。再也不需要像以前那样一个个填写了。。。

48块钱一年也不贵，希望将来涨价也不要波及我们这些先订阅的早鸟用户。
localization-master.author: 周杰伦鸟巢演唱会

localization-master.title: Best Price with Accessible UI
localization-master.body:
For all the apps I’ve tried for localization, here are the things I love the most about this app:

1. It’s the most affordable 
2. No setup required. It handles everything on its side like the Google Translate, ChatGPT, etc. But I also don’t mind providing my keys if it maintains the affordability of the sub.
3. You can reload the file with a single click, not all apps do this.
4. You can overwrite the file with a single click too, again, not all apps do this.
5. You can see every translation in every language in a single view
6. You can also add a new language in a single click.
7. It covers a lot of languages and easy to request a new language
8. You can see the translation progress as it happens
9. It exports in a clean format that is also easily readable

There are some things that can be improved though, which I hope the developer can do:

1. Whenever I overwrite my localization using the app, it also removes the "State" like "Don’t Translate", which means I have to update the states all over again.
2. I have to drag and drop the localization file every time I open the app, would be great to just click the most recent file.
3. Scrolling can be laggy. I’m fine with showing just 10 to 50 rows at a time if that improves performance.
4. Not sure if it takes into account the "Comment" section when translating, but would be great to have that too, and mentioned in the App Store page.

Overall, it has the best price and the most accessible UI so far.
localization-master.author: Ygee07

This is just what I needed for batch image processing. Worth every penny for the time it saved. Genius little app and something you don’t realize you need until the time comes where you need it. 

Extremely thankful that it is not subscription based, and I can just pay once and use it. I don’t even mind paying for upgrades, but the subscription model doesn’t work for those of us that use apps like these once in a blue moon. Thank you Devs for the one time payment model.

If I can think of anything to help make this app better, I’ll send an email or update the review, but so far… perfect, chef’s kiss.

epub-cover-maker.title: Almost perfect!
epub-cover-maker.body:
This is very convenient to have on the phone, I have a few suggestions, since this is a new app, maybe the dev would consider. 

1) Would be great to be able to add the series name & volume in the metadata of the epub. 

2) When adding an image from the camera roll, it would be great to be able to write the name of the book with whatever fonts are installed in the iPhone & the option to change the color of the fonts. The templates provided are not very aesthetic.

3) Lastly, an option to remove any unnecessary images or metadata from the epub to reduce size. 

I really want to purchase lifetime, but I’m gonna wait & see if any new features are added in the next few months.
